text:
dan: quick sync re: postmortem follow-ups for the KV fragmentation / OOM series. want to lock owners and timelines.
rina: i'm happy to own the GC tuning ticket and test plan. ETA for first experiment: 1 week.
carlos: i'll take limits + safe-fallback routing (we should fail faster rather than OOM). putting a ticket in now.
infra-bot: alert: recurring OOM pattern detected on cluster serve-west between 2024-04-18 and 2024-05-22 (5 events). aggregated metrics linked: https://monitoring.redwood/oom-trends
dan: thanks bot. @rina can you confirm which thresholds you'll try? we previously had gc_low=0.25 which seemed too low.
rina: plan: try gc_low=0.4, gc_aggressive_window=30s, enable compact-on-idle=true. will run on canary group k8s-phi first.
carlos: for limits i propose per-shard soft-evict at 80% and hard at 92%. soft eviction should trigger async compact.
ops-sre: note: soft-evict will increase tail latency if eviction kicks in too often. recommend tying to percentiles (p95 > threshold).
dan: good point. add a monitoring alert to the ledger to watch p99 and p95 latency delta when soft-evict occurs.ina: creating tests: synthetic workload that writes many small keys + intermittent large keys to create fragmentation. sketch here:
rina: ```
# workload pseudocode
for i in range(0, 10000):
  put(key=f"small-{i}", value=random_bytes(128))
  if i % 250 == 0:
    put(key=f"big-{i}", value=random_bytes(1_000_000))
  sleep(5ms)
```
carlos: will add a safepath: when free memory drops < 1.2GB on node, redirect new traffic to spare nodes and throttle new sessions.
dan: owners summary so far: rina=GC tuning + canary tests, carlos=limits+routing, ops-sre=monitoring & alert knobs. i'll own cross-team comms and timeline.
infra-bot: incident created: #INC-5012 linked to this thread (oom-regression-repeat)
rina: rina: i'll post weekly 1-line updates in the frag-ledger doc under my row. link: https://redwood.internal/frag-ledger/lines
carlos: added ticket RED-3421 with acceptance criteria and rollback plan.
ops-sre: I'll prototype the dashboard panel showing frag_ratio, kv_alloc_rate, and p95 tail delta. aiming for Wed.
dan: timeline check: canaries next Tue, collect 48h of metrics, decision Thurs. are we aligned?
rina: aligned.
carlos: aligned.
ops-sre: aligned.
dan: final ask: owners please add ETA to the ledger rows and ping if any blocker. closing thread once ledger updated. :thumbsup:
filename_note: KV fragmentation / OOM follow-up owners and timeline
